context.//backends: Comma list of model backends the worker loads: wan2.2 (Apache-2.0, default), h3 (MiniMax H3 Community License: you need a license from MiniMax in the US, EU, UK and Republic of Korea; read THIRD_PARTY_MODELS.md).
context.//auth: iam = SigV4 callers (AWS_IAM). jwt = your IdP (Cognito, Okta, Entra ID) via media:jwtDiscoveryUrl + media:jwtAllowedClients or media:jwtAllowedAudience. There is no unauthenticated mode.
context.//gpu: Spot first by priority order; onDemand=true switches the purchase option. maxInstances caps horizontal fan-out (one job per GPU at a time).
context.//network: Default = new VPC, public subnets, no inbound rules. privateNetworking=true adds private subnets + one NAT gateway. Or bring your own: vpcId + subnetIds (must have egress).
context.//safety: guardrail = create (default Bedrock Guardrail on prompts) | none | <guardrail-id>:<version> (bring your own). outputModeration samples frames through Amazon Rekognition and quarantines flagged renders.
context.//data: kms = customer managed key for bucket, table, queue and topic. Retention in days.
context.//limits: Per-caller daily job cap (0 = off) and a global queue depth cap.
